title: Embers of the Fallen
summary: The Queen is bound, and the fallen burn on beside Adela's ember.

epilogue.title: The Embers
epilogue.text: The embers of the fallen rose beside Adela's and the tree burned brighter for them. Their seats on the Express stay aired.

epilogue.title: The Embers
epilogue.text: A single ember rose beside Adela's, and the tree burned brighter for it. Its seat on the Express stays aired.
